snippet.title: Your Way Out - Trailer
snippet.description:
A game about finding your way out of the sewers and the secret of the rats.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4930730/Your_Way_Out/

One push in a dark alley and you're down in the sewers. Your lighter won't last long, so every trip into the dark counts: collect junk, sell it to Rattus the rat trader and upgrade your gear. Fuel, glow sticks, a flashlight, a crowbar, a bigger backpack. Bring the power back for a few precious minutes and find out the secret of the rats.

Your Way Out is made by DeDo Studios, a three-person team from Germany, in Unreal Engine.
Out on Steam on October 29, 2026 for Windows and macOS, in 11 languages.

Website: https://dedostudios.com
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dedostudiosde
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dedostudios/
